summary: Iteration 4 – Scan History feature end-to-end validated. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass (auth guard, scan persistence with scan_id, GET history newest-first excluding _id/user_id, soft-delete happy path, 404 for missing / already-deleted / other-user scans, compound index user_id:1 + created_at:-1 present, regression: /auth/me, /profile, /preferences, /auth/logout). Frontend (Expo web preview, mobile viewport 390x844): logged in as QA account, navigated to Scanner, verified the 'पिछले स्कैन' (Recent scans) list renders seeded history cards with thumbnail + diagnosis + timestamp + top remedy, tapping a history card opens scanner-result with stored image and remedies, trash button removes item optimistically (count 2→1) and the deletion persists after tab-switch refresh, scanner-camera and scanner-gallery buttons render. No React Native red screen. All required testIDs present.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' – styles.image sets resizeMode via StyleSheet at ScannerScreen.tsx:233. Non-blocking, but should migrate to prop for React Native 0.79+.

action_items: Optional: move `resizeMode: 'cover'` from StyleSheet into the Image prop on ScannerScreen.tsx to silence RN deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend excludes _id and user_id from GET /scan/history payload correctly.
Soft-delete uses update_one with matched_count check – returns 404 for non-owner and already-deleted cases as intended.
Compound index (user_id asc, created_at desc) created on startup as required.
ScannerScreen uses testIDs consistently and reloads history after a successful scan via loadHistory().
seed_data_creation: Temporarily inserted 2 TEST_UI_ scan_history rows for the QA user to drive the UI test; cleaned up after the run. Ephemeral TEST_other_* signup rows and their scans were also created/cleaned inside the pytest 'other user' test.
